gr-01-c2.text: Sean M. Carroll (1997). Lecture Notes on General Relativity. arXiv gr-qc/9712019 (Institute for Theoretical Physics, UC Santa Barbara).
gr-01-c2.quote: Once we have a metric, however, there is automatically a unique torsion-free metric-compatible connection.
gr-01-c2.claim: They're the connection coefficients of the unique torsion-free metric-compatible connection, called the Levi-Civita connection, and they're computed entirely from the metric

gr-01-c3.text: Sean M. Carroll (1997). Lecture Notes on General Relativity. arXiv gr-qc/9712019 (Institute for Theoretical Physics, UC Santa Barbara).
gr-01-c3.quote: We have already argued, using the two-sphere as an example, that parallel transport of a vector around a closed loop in a curved space will lead to a transformation of the vector.
gr-01-c3.claim: Parallel transport around a closed loop measures curvature: carry a tangent vector around a small loop on a sphere and it comes back rotated.

gr-07-c3.text: B. P. Abbott et al. (LIGO Scientific Collaboration and Virgo Collaboration) (2016). Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger. Physical Review Letters 116, 061102 (arXiv).
gr-07-c3.quote: This is the first direct detection of gravitational waves and the first observation of a binary black hole merger.
gr-07-c3.claim: This was GW150914, the first direct detection of gravitational waves and the first direct observation of a binary black hole merger.

gr-05-c2.text: University of Cambridge (2020). Roger Penrose wins 2020 Nobel Prize in Physics for discovery about black holes. University of Cambridge Research News.
gr-05-c2.quote: for the discovery that black hole formation is a robust prediction of the general theory of relativity
gr-05-c2.claim: central to his 1965 singularity theorem (Nobel 2020) showing that gravitational collapse generically forms a singularity inside any trapped surface

gr-08-c3.text: Adam G. Riess et al (1998). Observational Evidence from Supernovae for an Accelerating Universe and a Cosmological Constant. The Astronomical Journal 116, 1009 (arXiv).
gr-08-c3.quote: The distances of the high-redshift SNe Ia are, on average, 10% to 15% farther than expected

gr-07-c2.text: J. M. Weisberg, D. J. Nice, J. H. Taylor (2010). Timing Measurements of the Relativistic Binary Pulsar PSR B1913+16. The Astrophysical Journal 722, 1030 (arXiv).
gr-07-c2.quote: has been decreasing at a rate $0.997\pm0.002$ times that predicted
